NBL Rosetta Matches

Source: R/nbl_rosetta.R
nbl_rosetta_matches.Rd

Matches of a season: ids, teams, venue, status, scores and start time (UTC).

Endpoint: GET https://prod.rosetta.nbl.com.au/get/{org}/matches/in/season/{season}/{season_type}

Usage

nbl_rosetta_matches(
  season,
  org = "nbl",
  season_type = "all",
  limit = NULL,
  offset = NULL
)

Arguments

season

(integer required): Season END year (2026 = 2025-26). The runtime maps it to Rosetta's year: the START year for the NBL and WNBL from 1998-99, the calendar year for NBL1 and the NBL / WNBL winter seasons up to 1998. END 1998 and 1999 both read Rosetta year 1998, which holds two seasons; the matches frame keeps the one asked for.

org

(character default "nbl"): Organisation: nbl (men's NBL), wnbl (women's) or nbl1 (the second tier, men's and women's conferences). One of "nbl", "wnbl", "nbl1".

season_type

(character default "all"): Season type: all (every type of the year), regular (includes finals), preseason, in_season (cups, Blitz, NBAxNBL, All-Star) or test. One of "all", "regular", "preseason", "in_season", "test".

limit

(integer default NULL): Rows to return. Omitted = a page large enough for the whole list (a short page cut by Rosetta's path cache is refused).

offset

(integer default NULL): Rows to skip. Pages can overlap, so prefer one large limit.

Value

A hoopR_data tibble (one row per match):

col_nametypedescription
orgcharacterOrganisation the row belongs to: nbl, wnbl or nbl1. From the row's competition, else from the request.
match_idcharacterDataCore fixture id (UUID v1); equal to id.
external_media_idcharacterMedia id. Through NBL25 (2024-25): the Genius Sports match id (7 digits, e.g. 2636769; 6 or fewer in older seasons). From NBL26: mostly an 8-digit number of unverified origin (e.g. 61386925), date-like codes on some games (05042026 = DDMMYYYY on the 2026 Championship game, 1409252 = DDMMYY + n on the Blitz), null on many preseason games. NBL1 and WNBL 2025 carry 8-digit numbers.
date_updatedcharacterRecord last-edit time, ISO 8601 UTC.
start_timecharacterTip-off, UTC, with no offset or a Z suffix (ESPN dates the same Perth v SE Melbourne game 2025-12-18T10:30Z; Rosetta says 2025-12-18T10:30:00)
start_time_datetimecharacterTip-off, UTC; same value as start_time.
roundcharacterRound label: a number as a string in the regular season ("13"), words in the finals ("SEMI FINAL SERIES 1", "CHAMPIONSHIP")
match_typecharacterMatch type: regular, final (FINAL upper case seen)
match_statuscharacterStatus of the match in Rosetta's words (complete for a finished game): box score and play-by-play of any other status are partial.
statuscharacterProvider fixture status: CONFIRMED, SCHEDULED.
home_scoreintegerHome final score, a STRING; null before tip-off.
away_scoreintegerAway final score, a STRING; null before tip-off.
attendanceintegerAttendance, a STRING; null when not recorded.
match_slugcharacterURL slug of the match page on nbl.com.au.
match_titlecharacterMatch title ("<home> v <away> <men/women> DD-MM-YYYY")
venue_idcharacterDataCore id (UUID v1, Sportradar) of the venue; stable across seasons and the id to join on across routes.
rosetta_venue_idcharacterRosetta's own id (UUID v4; v5 on NBL1) of the venue; routes that take this entity accept it as well as the DataCore id.
venue_namecharacterName of the venue (arena), e.g. RAC Arena.
venue_addresscharacterUnobserved in samples (null in every capture); type and meaning unverified.
venue_suburbcharacterUnobserved in samples (null in every capture); type and meaning unverified.
venue_statecharacterUnobserved in samples (null in every capture); type and meaning unverified.
venue_countrycharacterCountry; often null.
venue_capacityintegerUnobserved in samples (null in every capture); type and meaning unverified.
venue_timezonecharacterIANA time zone of the venue, e.g. Australia/Sydney.
venue_codecharacterVenue code; often null.
venue_latitudedoubleUnobserved in samples (null in every capture); type and meaning unverified.
venue_longitudedoubleUnobserved in samples (null in every capture); type and meaning unverified.
home_team_idcharacterDataCore id (UUID v1, Sportradar) of the home team; stable across seasons and the id to join on across routes.
rosetta_home_team_idcharacterRosetta's own id (UUID v4; v5 on NBL1) of the home team; routes that take this entity accept it as well as the DataCore id.
home_team_namecharacterDisplay name of the team.
home_team_external_team_namecharacterTeam name as DataCore spells it.
home_team_codecharacterTeam code of the home team, e.g. PER or SYD.
home_team_division_abbreviationcharacterDivision code, e.g. EM (East Men)
home_team_division_namecharacterDivision name (NBL1 conference + gender)
home_team_conference_namecharacterName of the NBL1 conference of the home team; null outside NBL1.
away_team_idcharacterDataCore id (UUID v1, Sportradar) of the away team; stable across seasons and the id to join on across routes.
rosetta_away_team_idcharacterRosetta's own id (UUID v4; v5 on NBL1) of the away team; routes that take this entity accept it as well as the DataCore id.
away_team_namecharacterDisplay name of the team.
away_team_external_team_namecharacterTeam name as DataCore spells it.
away_team_codecharacterTeam code of the away team, e.g. PER or SYD.
away_team_division_abbreviationcharacterDivision code, e.g. EM (East Men)
away_team_division_namecharacterDivision name (NBL1 conference + gender)
away_team_conference_namecharacterName of the NBL1 conference of the away team; null outside NBL1.
season_idcharacterDataCore id (UUID v1, Sportradar) of the season; stable across seasons and the id to join on across routes.
rosetta_season_idcharacterRosetta's own id (UUID v4; v5 on NBL1) of the season; routes that take this entity accept it as well as the DataCore id.
season_namecharacterSeason name (NBL26, WNBL 2024/25, 2025 South Men)
season_yearintegerRosetta's year of the season: the START year for the NBL and WNBL from 1998-99 (2025 = 2025-26), the calendar year for NBL1 and the 1979-1997 winter seasons. See season_end_year for the sdv key.
season_typecharacterSeason type: regular (includes finals), preseason, in_season (cups, blitz, exhibition), test.
season_gendercharacterGender (MALE/FEMALE upper case on seasons and players, male/female lower case on competitions and divisions; UNKNOWN seen)
season_competition_idcharacterRosetta competition id (UUID v4)
season_competition_namecharacterName of the competition the season belongs to (e.g. NBL, WNBL, NBL1 North Men).
season_competition_gendercharacterGender (MALE/FEMALE upper case on seasons and players, male/female lower case on competitions and divisions; UNKNOWN seen)
season_competition_league_namecharacterName of the league the competition belongs to (NBL, WNBL or NBL1).
season_competition_divisioncharacterNBL1 divisions (conference x gender); empty for NBL and WNBL.
season_end_yearintegersdv season key: the END year of the season (2026 = 2025-26), derived from season_year (a START year for the NBL and WNBL from 1998-99, a calendar year for NBL1 and the 1979-1997 winter seasons; year 1998 is split on the start date). Where the body carries no year it is the season asked for.
home_team_divisioncharacterNBL1 divisions (conference x gender); empty for NBL and WNBL.
home_team_conferencecharacterConference of the division.
away_team_divisioncharacterNBL1 divisions (conference x gender); empty for NBL and WNBL.
away_team_conferencecharacterConference of the division.

Columns the body adds beyond these follow, in body order (sdv-py keeps them too).

Details

  • Unofficial: the JSON proxy behind nbl.com.au (not an API the NBL documents or supports). The terms of use were not reviewed; payloads are not redistributed as release assets.

  • Gated by a referer, not a key: every request carries Origin / Referer set to nbl.com.au (the runtime sends them); without them the host answers 403 MISSING_API_KEY, which is raised as hoopR_asset_fetch.

  • Fills a hole in ESPN: ESPN's nbl feed has box scores but no plays for the 2025-26 NBL season (the stats provider changed from Genius Sports to Sportradar DataCore that year). nbl_rosetta_match_pbp has the full event log with shot x/y for 2025-26 and, in the same shape, back to 2011-12 (WNBL about 2014-15). Matches from 1979 have box scores only.

  • One host serves three organisations; pass org='nbl' (default), 'wnbl' or 'nbl1'. NBL1 is the second tier (men's and women's conferences, calendar-year seasons).

  • Season = the END year (2026 = 2025-26) everywhere. Rosetta's own year is the START year for the NBL and WNBL from 1998-99 and a calendar year for NBL1 and the 1979-1997 winter seasons; the runtime maps it. Year 1998 holds two seasons (calendar 1998 and 1998-99).

  • Ids: <entity>id columns are DataCore ids (UUID v1; join on them), rosetta<entity>_id Rosetta's own. match_id is the DataCore fixture id every match route is keyed on.

  • Unknown ids, orgs and types answer 200 with no rows (hoopR_no_data). Rosetta caches a body per path and serves it whatever the query string, so a page cut by someone else's limit is refused (hoopR_asset_fetch); retry after the cache entry expires.

Errors: hoopR_no_data when Rosetta answers 404 or no rows (an unknown match, team, player or season id, an org or season type with nothing, or no season in progress); hoopR_asset_fetch for the 403 gate body, a stub or error envelope, a page cut by Rosetta's path cache, a body for another org, season or entity than the one asked for, or any other failed fetch; hoopR_bad_request for an unknown org / season_type, a malformed id, or HTTP 400 / 422.
